meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后,当讨论 Azure 配额或容量时,Claude 会用 Azure CLI 查询资源的配额上限、当前用量和可用余量,也可跨区域比较或提交配额提升请求,并以表格或数值返回结果。
howto.when: 当你说出 “check quotas”“service limits” 等关键词,或要求验证容量、选择区域、申请配额提升时触发。

say.text: 查一下 eastus 区域的计算配额还剩多少
say.note: 返回该区域各配额的限额、用量和可用余量。

say.text: 帮我把 standardDSv3Family 配额上限提到 500
say.note: 会提交配额提升请求并显示审批状态。

say.text: 比较 eastus 和 westus2 的 vCPU 可用容量
say.note: 逐区域查询限额和用量,列出哪些区域有余量。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will use Azure CLI to query Azure quota limits, current usage, and available capacity, compare across regions, or submit increase requests, returning tables or values.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "check quotas" or "service limits", or ask to validate capacity, select a region, or request a quota increase.

say_en.text: Check how much compute quota is left in eastus
say_en.note: Returns limits, usage, and available capacity per quota.

say_en.text: Raise the standardDSv3Family quota limit to 500
say_en.note: Submits the increase request and shows approval status.

say_en.text: Compare vCPU availability in eastus and westus2
say_en.note: Queries limits and usage per region, lists which have capacity.
